display.purpose: Oversized project covers and section headlines.

body.purpose: Readable narrative and project case notes.

label.purpose: Technical metadata, indices, captions, and compact controls.

shadows.name: evidence-sheet
shadows.purpose: Hard offset that makes a report or index feel like a physical sheet.

shadows.name: evidence-ambient
shadows.purpose: Subtle separation beneath a large evidence plate.

motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: Small color and border state changes on controls.

motion.name: report-lift
motion.purpose: Quiet, eased lift for evidence plates.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Remove nonessential motion while retaining content and control affordances.

narrative.overview: Forensic clarity, not a white-first theme. Arrange evidence deliberately and make it easy to examine while retaining the Archive, Hazard, and Blueprint palette system.
keyCharacteristics: Large display typography with mono technical labels
Structural paper layers and atmospheric depth

rules.name: The Three-Mode Rule
rules.body: Keep Archive as the default and cycle Archive → Hazard → Blueprint → Archive.

rules.name: The Physical-Evidence Rule
rules.body: A shadow must communicate a physical layer or scene depth; remove decorative floating-card shadows.

dos: Do show evidence before claims and label public, private, and withheld material accurately.
Do keep all core content usable at phone widths, with keyboard access, focus visibility, readable contrast, and reduced-motion support.
donts: Don't use generic neon hacker styling or stock cyber imagery.
Don't use template-like SaaS dashboards or repetitive card grids.
Don't publish private commercial work, repositories, or evidence without approval.

components.name: Footer Audio Toggle
components.description: Explicit user-controlled soundtrack play/mute toggle at the end of the page.

components.name: Evidence Plate
components.description: A fixed-ratio exhibit surface for diagrams, original documents, and project evidence.

components.name: Report Index Item
components.description: A numbered case-file link with project type and year metadata.
components.css: .ds-report-index{display:grid;grid-template-columns:2rem minmax(0,1fr) auto;align-items:baseline;gap:.65rem;padding:.62rem .5rem;border-top:1px solid rgba(var(--color-primary-rgb),.12);color:var(--color-primary);text-decoration:none}.ds-report-index:hover,.ds-report-index:focus-visible{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--color-secondary) 12%,transparent);outline:1px solid var(--color-secondary)}.ds-report-index small{font:400 8px/1.4 var(--font-family-fraktion);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase}
